verdict.rationale: Only community evidence shows that Google Cloud offers a first-party managed Kubernetes service: GKE is named and praised, users mention Kubernetes clusters in the console, and a hands-on report uses `gcloud container clusters get-credentials`. No first-party documentation in the pack describes GKE, its upgrade policy, or its autoscaling. Missing for 10: first-party GKE docs, documented upgrade/release-channel policy, documented cluster/node autoscaling, independent corroboration of upgrade and autoscaling behavior.
